_comment: Near-miss distractors used by `make run`. Each is the SAME quantity/variables as the target's correct card but subtly WRONG — the dangerous kind a model can grab and compute a plausible-but-wrong answer. Phrased to sound legitimate (a confident wrong card is what actually fools a model).

astro-004.name: escape-velocity-energy-form
astro-004.when: Speed needed to escape the gravity well from radius r. (WRONG: this is the circular-orbit speed; escape speed is larger by sqrt(2). Plausible near-miss.)

astro-016.name: hill-sphere-radius

variables.a_planet: planet's semi-major axis around the Sun [m]

astro-016.when: Region where the planet's gravity dominates over the Sun's. (A genuinely confusable alternative — this is the Hill sphere, not the Laplace sphere of influence, which uses exponent 2/5 not 1/3.)

astro-027.name: hyperbolic-deflection-angle-acos
astro-027.when: Turn angle of a hyperbolic flyby in a single-body field. (WRONG inverse function: the turn angle uses asin(1/e), not acos(1/e).)
